message: 七大猫魔少女
Demons had been spotted in various other places as well.
Every last one of them is heading toward Finis Tower on the hill.

name: Sally
message: 「You know what they say--fools and smoke love high places」

name: Nanaka
message: 「And what about you, Sally-chan?」

name: Sally
message: 「I love high places!!」

name: Misa
message: 「It looks like quite a massive number are pouring in」

name: Shio
message: 「One warrior worth a thousand. Allow me to lead the vanguard first」

name: Misa
message: 「Shio, you're needed for the final blow, remember?」

name: Shio
message: 「Ooh! To be entrusted with such a vital role. I shall keep this power in reserve」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Chairwoman. I have a small favor to ask……」

name: Helena
message: 「Understood. Intrusion authorized」

name: Lolotte
message: 「A message from Jeeves. Heavy enemy presence. He says to exercise the utmost caution」

name: Synn
message: 「A private line, huh……」

name: Ria
message: 「Everyone. Are you ready?」
We've gone through all kinds of special training just for this moment.

name: Synn
message: 「I'm good to go!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hold it right there!」
「Nyahahaha. Talk about moths flying straight into the flame, nyan♪」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh……」
Mixed in among the usual doll-like demons is someone with a human form.
No--the demons are actually lined up in formation around that kid.

name: Synn
message: 「That kid is…… a child?」

name: Pasta
message: 「Nyaaa!! Don't treat Pasta like a child, nyaa!!」

name: Pasta
message: 「Despite how I look, Pasta is one of the Seven Demon Generals. And these guys are Pasta's loyal minions, nyan」

name: Cat Demon
message: 「Nyaa!!」

name: Synn
message: 「So that means the mastermind causing all this commotion at the academy is……」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah, this one's definitely the choice」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Speaking of the Seven Demon Generals, wasn't Sally-chan's Boss one of them too?」

name: Sally
message: 「Ahh. Now that you mention it, was there someone like that?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Omake-san, why do you always forget such important things?」

name: Sally
message: 「Because who cares, right? Forget about that, I wanna eat something delicious」

name: Pasta
message: 「Calling it 'who cares'--you sure say whatever you want, nyan!」

name: Pasta
message: 「I won't forgive anyone who gets in my way!! I'll tear you to pieces right here, nyaa!!」
